knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 2.4.2
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. (1) How does a series expansion of an MGF yield moments? (2) In one sentence, how can differentiation of a GF produce a moment (CMP idea)?
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Moments appear as coefficients in the Taylor series of the MGF (scaled as in the CMP). Differentiating the MGF and evaluating at t=0 (or equivalent CMP operation) recovers moments.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.
